sentences.la: Ā Mārcō inimīcus fessus vocātur.
sentences.en: By Marcus the tired enemy is called.

sentences.la: Domina bona ā līberīs accūsātur.
sentences.en: The good mistress is accused by the children.

sentences.la: Iūlia ā puellā vidētur, nōn ab inimīcō.
sentences.en: Julia is seen by the girl, not by the enemy.

sentences.la: Cūr Mēdus ā patribus amīcīs vidētur?
sentences.en: Why is Medus seen by the friendly fathers?

sentences.la: Ursus baculō ā puerīs verberātur.
sentences.en: Ursus is beaten with a stick by the boys.

sentences.la: Līberī ab inimīcīs, nōn baculō, verberantur.
sentences.en: The children are beaten by the enemies, not with a stick.

sentences.la: Ā Mārcō titulus novus vidētur.
sentences.en: By Marcus the new title is seen.

sentences.la: Cornēlius malus ā dominīs vocātur.
sentences.en: Bad Cornelius is called by the mistresses.

sentences.la: Māter ā dominā salūtātur, nōn ā Syrā.
sentences.en: The mother is greeted by the mistress, not by Syra.

sentences.la: Cūr fēminae ā fīliīs improbīs salūtantur?
sentences.en: Why are the women greeted by the bad sons?

sentences.la: Inimīcī baculō ā Mārcō pulsantur.
sentences.en: The enemies are hit with a stick by Marcus.

sentences.la: Fīliī ā Dēliā, nōn baculō, verberantur.
sentences.en: The sons are beaten by Delia, not with a stick.

sentences.la: Ā Cornēliō Ursus Graecus dēlectātur.
sentences.en: By Cornelius Greek Ursus is delighted.

sentences.la: Ursus probus ā virīs dēlectātur.
sentences.en: Good Ursus is delighted by the men.

sentences.la: Ancilla ab Iūliā vidētur, nōn ab Ursō.
sentences.en: The slave girl is seen by Julia, not by Ursus.

sentences.la: Cūr mātrēs ab ancillīs pulchrīs accūsantur?
sentences.en: Why are the mothers accused by the beautiful slave girls?

sentences.la: Mārcus baculō ā Lȳdiā verberātur.
sentences.en: Marcus is beaten with a stick by Lydia.

sentences.la: Ab inimīcīs suīs puer nōn accūsātur.
sentences.en: The boy is not accused by his enemies.

sentences.la: Iūlia ab amīcīs, nōn baculō, pulsātur.
sentences.en: Julia is hit by the friends, not with a stick.

sentences.la: Ā Syrā servī bonī audiuntur.
sentences.en: By Syra the good slaves are heard.

sentences.la: Pāgina Latīna ā mātre vidētur.
sentences.en: The Latin page is seen by the mother.
